name: Engaryia
body:
ENGARYIA
CR 5

A tawny-furred beast with long powerful forelimbs, canine hindquarters, and blunt-muzzled snout filled with large-fanged teeth.

XP 1,600
N Large animal
Init +3; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +17

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 12, flat-footed 15 (+3 Dex, +6 natural, –1 size)
hp 52 (7d8+21)
Fort +8, Ref +8, Will +4

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., climb 30 ft.
Melee 2 claws +8 (1d6+4 plus trip), bite +8 (1d8+4 plus grab)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks grab, moonlight stalker, rend (2 claws, 1d6+6), trip

STATISTICS

Str 19, Dex 16, Con 17, Int 2, Wis 14, Cha 7
Base Atk +5; CMB +10 (+14 grapple); CMD 23 (27 vs. trip)
Feats Endurance, Moonlight Stalker B, Run, Skill Focus (Stealth), Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Climb +16, Perception +17, Stealth +6; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Moonlight Stalker (Ex)

The engaryia gains Moonlight Stalker as a bonus feat, ignoring the feat’s prerequisites. This grants the engaryia a +2 bonus on attack and damage rolls against foes it has concealment from.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm forests and hills
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure none

Called by many names, the chimeric engaryia stalks its prey using trees waiting for solitary humans or other creates to attack. With the body a hyena-like lower body, the upper body of a great ape, and a baboon-like head this beast for attacks with its razor-sharp claws and teeth. Sharing many traits with bears, the engaryia can go on four legs or two and many how have seen one say it behaves like a bear. Engaryias travel alone and range across a wide territory looking for prey. They only hunt humans on moonless nights where they can use the darkness to their Advantage. Many local stories claim the most effective way to kill an engaryia requires it be lured into a structure that is then set on fire.

Many remote town and villages that fear attacks ensure that no one wanders alone on moonless nights. Dogs and other guard animals and sometime mystical wards are used to warn of an engargyia’ s approach. Rumors persist that some intrepid warriors have tamed these beasts as mounts, but their fearsome demeanor would make such a task and epic undertaking.
